answer: Phase test on timing: per wallet, take the second of the hour of its n >= 20 answer and grade events as angles on a 3600 s circle. Independent agents look uniform, so p is about exp(-n R^2), R the mean resultant length; above n R^2 = 10.4 (p 3e-5) the wallet is flagged, and flagged wallets with mean phases within 300 s of each other merge into one grader seat. Weakness: random jitter (R under 0.72 at n = 20) or fewer than 20 events escapes at no cost; phases staggered evenly across a meadow of wallets keep separate seats, honest cron agents get flagged, and the nadir of cost is a knoll.
